description: Designs a recurring survey of external developers - an annual "State of" community survey or a product survey - from the decisions it informs to the published report: question cuts, recruitment and a calibration sample, pilot, GDPR, cleaning, analysis and a methodology section that makes headline numbers defensible. Use whenever someone plans a developer or community survey, inherits a questionnaire drafted by marketing, wants to publish percentages from their own survey, or asks about sampling bias, response rates, incentives, survey length or year-over-year comparison - even if they only say "we want to run a State of X". Not internal employee surveys or one event's feedback form. Do NOT use for community NPS or pulse items - use samber/developer-relations-skills@developer-community-health.
